subject: Need FD approval: --fd-text-3 contrast token (#6E7681) fails WCAG on dark bg
body:
FD — GA needs design approval before changing a token that originated from your design system.

ISSUE
GD audit found: --fd-text-3 = #6E7681 on index.html dark background (--bg-page-dark = #0D1117).
Contrast ratio: 3.52:1. WCAG 1.4.3 requires 4.5:1 for normal text.

AFFECTED FILE
index.html only. This token is used in dashboard secondary text elements.

OPTIONS
Option A: Change --fd-text-3 to #8A9099 (approx 4.6:1 on dark bg, visually very close).
Option B: Override the value only in index.html dark mode block (don't change the token globally).
Option C: This text is decorative or disabled-state only — WCAG exemption may apply. FD to confirm.

Waiting for your direction before making any change. This is your token — GA will not touch it without FD sign-off.

Low urgency if Option C applies. If Option A or B, GA can implement in 5 minutes.
